0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Portland Trail Blazers host the Phoenix Suns. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery) and is listed day-to-day with Chris Youngblood (calf soreness), Jrue Holiday (hand soreness), and Micah Potter (illness), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and is day-to-day with Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip soreness). In the 2025-26 season series the Trail Blazers lost 1-2, but they won their most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
